task: Create pelican.html: a web page with an inline SVG drawing of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the drawing recognizable: bicycle wheels, frame, and the pelican with its big beak.

args.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Pelican Riding a Bicycle</title>
    <style>
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f8ff;
        }
        svg {
            border: 2px solid #333;
            background-color: white;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <svg width="400" height="500" viewBox="0 0 400 500">
        <!-- Background sky -->
        <rect width="400" height="500" fill="#87CEEB"/>
        
        <!-- Ground -->
        <rect y="380" width="400" height="120" fill="#90EE90"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Rear Wheel -->
        <circle cx="150" cy="380" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
        <circle cx="150" cy="380" r="55" fill="none" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="2"/>
        <!-- Spokes -->
        <line x1="150" y1="320" x2="150" y2="440" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="90" y1="380" x2="210" y2="380" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="125" y1="345" x2="185" y2="415" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="185" y1="345" x2="125" y2="415" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Front Wheel -->
        <circle cx="250" cy="380" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
        <circle cx="250" cy="380" r="55" fill="none" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="2"/>
        <!-- Spokes -->
        <line x1="250" y1="320" x2="250" y2="440" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="190" y1="380" x2="310" y2="380" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="225" y1="345" x2="285" y2="415" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="285" y1="345" x2="225" y2="415" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
        <path d="M 150 380 L 210 320 L 250 380" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
        <path d="M 150 380 L 190 360 L 250 380" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
        <path d="M 250 380 L 270 350 L 290 380" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Handlebars -->
        <circle cx="260" cy="180" r="5" fill="#333"/>
        <path d="M 260 180 L 290 170" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Seat -->
        <ellipse cx="140" cy="250" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#666"/>
        <path d="M 140 242 L 135 250 L 145 250 Z" fill="#666"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Body -->
        <ellipse cx="270" cy="280" rx="40" ry="35" fill="#FFDAB9" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Neck -->
        <path d="M 270 245 Q 265 210 280 190" stroke="#FFDAB9" stroke-width="25" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Head -->
        <circle cx="280" cy="170" r="22" fill="#FFDAB9" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Big Beak -->
        <path d="M 280 155 Q 340 165 340 190 L 320 210 Q 290 200 280 175 Z" fill="#FFA500" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M 280 155 Q 340 165 340 190 L 320 210 Q 290 200 280 175 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Eye -->
        <circle cx="285" cy="165" r="3" fill="black"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Wing (left) -->
        <path d="M 270 280 Q 240 290 230 270 Q 240 250 260 260" fill="#FFDAB9" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Wing (right) -->
        <path d="M 270 280 Q 300 290 310 270 Q 300 250 280 260" fill="#FFDAB9" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Legs -->
        <path d="M 245 310 L 245 370" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M 295 310 L 295 370" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        
        <!-- Title -->
        <text x="20" y="30" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#333">Pelican on Bicycle</text>
    </svg>
</body>
</html>

args.message:
Created pelican.html with an inline SVG drawing of a pelican riding a bicycle. The illustration includes:
- Two bicycle wheels with spokes
- Bicycle frame connecting the wheels
- Handlebars and seat
- Pelican body, neck, head, wings, and legs
- Pelican's distinctive large orange beak
The file is ready to view in any web browser.
